utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Where is the repair drive taking place this time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's at the community center on Elm Street, right next to the park. We'll have tables set up in the main hall.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, I know that spot. I'll note it down so I can help with the setup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, just got Rosa's list for the repair drive this Saturday. Did you know Vik's bringing his toaster?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Actually, I heard Tess is bringing her old toaster. I've got the full list of supplies ready to share.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, I thought Vik was bringing his toaster? Rosa sent me a list too, maybe we should compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been organizing the supply list, and Oren just confirmed he'll bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that's good to hear. I can help carry things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rey. I'll mark you down for carrying supplies then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I've got my tools ready, added them to the list too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, which tools did you bring? I want to make sure we have everything for the drive repair.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think I brought a wrench and some screwdrivers, but you know me, I might have forgotten something.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, do you have a minute to talk about the repair drive schedule?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sure, what about it? I think it's Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's this Saturday. I was thinking we could use some help setting up the tables and organizing the donations.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, I heard about the repair drive. Need me to bring over my tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. That's kind. I might take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, just let me know when you need it. I've got a good set of wrenches and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm helping Eli sort through the tools for Gus's repair drive. He's got quite the collection!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What tools are we missing? I can start a list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We're short on screwdrivers and wrenches, I think. Can you add those?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time did we say the repair drive starts? I like to have everything scheduled.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think it's at 9 AM. I'm bringing my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 AM, good. I'll be there with my old coffee maker. Should I bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: What's the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's a community thing where we all pitch in to fix up shared spaces—like that broken bench at the park. Just a way to help out!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great! I'd love to help out—count me in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we checked if the repair drive has enough power to reach the shop and back?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we even have the right drive for this job?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure, but we should double-check the specifications before we start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive. I have an old laptop I can contribute.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, bring it Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Saturday morning sounds good, I'll bring it then.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive is this Saturday, don't forget!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll see you there. Need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Dane, do you have a schedule set for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I don't have a set schedule yet, but I can drop off that old laptop I mentioned whenever you need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, let's set a specific time then. How about tomorrow morning around 10?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Bo, are you helping out with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Repair drive? Oh, yeah, maybe. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We've got a few broken toys from the school playground, and some shelves that need mending. What are you handy with?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam's lifting the engine block now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need me to grab the engine hoist or any other tools?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nah, we're good—Sam's got it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Sam, that's so kind of you! I could really use someone to help sort through the donated tools on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds great, I'll be there on Saturday morning to help sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Uli, I heard you're coordinating the repair drive. I'd like to help, but could you tell me more about what's needed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We need basic tools and spare parts—anything folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you list some specific tools or parts that are most needed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive? We're fixing old appliances and could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got supplies sorted out. Oren is bringing tools, so we're set on that front.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Tess is bringing her old toaster too. I'll get that list of supplies to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, let's start listing what we have and what we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just worried we might not have enough supplies. Do we have a list of what's broken?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let's make that list right now—what exactly is broken?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, are you planning to help out with Gus's repair drive? Eli and I are organizing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Are we actually getting the right tools this time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Gus is making sure we have proper supplies this time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm bringing my toaster to the repair drive on Saturday. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely! I've got a blender that's been on the fritz, so I'll be there too. Maybe we can grab coffee afterwards?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you Saturday! Coffee after sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Tess, I brought my tools for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful, Oren! What kind of tools did you bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I... I think I brought a hammer and a few screwdrivers? Let me check my bag.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive is this Saturday, hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for letting me know, I'll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll save you a spot! What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the repair drive? Where exactly is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure about the exact spot—I got the date from Rosa, but maybe she knows where it's at? I can ask her.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Would you mind asking Rosa about the location? I'd like to know exactly where it's happening.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
